description: INSEED, the statistics institute of Chad, documents the Second General Population and Housing Census of 2008-2009 in its national statistical data archive. The archive lists three full-count files: population with 11,024,271 person records, deaths, and a habitat file with 1,993,651 household records and 44 variables. Every household is coded down to canton and enumeration zone. Habitat variables record whether the dwelling is fixed or mobile, the structure type and tenure, bedrooms, wall, roof and floor material, water supply, toilet type, disposal of household waste and wastewater, lighting and cooking fuel. Equipment variables cover radios, televisions, phones, fans, air conditioners, refrigerators and improved stoves, and transport items run from bicycles and motorcycles to carts, canoes and riding animals. Coverage is national, including nomadic households. Format and access: the data dictionary and DDI metadata are open; the microdata are released through a request to the national data centre, where approved researchers work on site. Licence: restricted access. Caveats: the data are from 2008-2009, and the new INSEED website lists the RGPH2 with no documents attached. Simulation uses: household-level building materials and service access by canton for exposure models and synthetic populations. Related records: the WorldPop GRID3 census-based population grids and IPUMS International.
